From: Sam Gupta <sam@buildstack.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Codelab demo request — BuildStack

Hi Mina,

I signed up through the docs Codelab CTA under the developer quickstart — thanks for the great content. We are evaluating Redwood to replace our in-house inference routing layer and would love a technical demo focused on:
- prefix/KV caching and cost/latency tradeoffs
- quantization profiles for L4/8-bit workloads
- private deployment options (VPC + KMS)

Team: Sam Gupta (lead ML engineer) + Alex Chen (platform eng). We are based in PST. Available windows next week: Mon/Tue 10am–1pm or Wed after 2pm PST.

Also: we have a short pre-demo questionnaire for vendors — happy to share it.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Gupta
Lead ML Engineer, BuildStack
sam@buildstack.io

Hi Sam — great to meet you (virtually) and glad the codelab was helpful.

Thanks for the availability — Ben (our SDR) will coordinate scheduling, and Camila from infra will run the technical demo to cover KV cache behavior, quant profiles, and private deployment options. Quick proposed slots based on your windows:
- Mon 11/23 10:30am PST
- Tue 11/24 11:00am PST
- Wed 11/25 2:30pm PST

If none of those work we can send a Calendly link. Can you also share your pre-demo questionnaire — we usually review it ahead of time so Camila can prepare any configs or logs you want to show.

I'm attaching a short mutual action plan template to capture agenda and success criteria (mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf).

A couple quick asks to prep Camila:
- We run mixed workloads (short chat-style prompts + long-context retrieval). Would appreciate a short walkthrough of batching and policy routing.
- Please include a few slides or a short demo snippet showing how Dedicated pools and VPCs are configured (high level).

I've attached our pre-demo questionnaire (pre-demo-questions.docx) — it's just a checklist of compliance and data-path questions.

Sam
